question.text: SEBI introduced REITs in India in which year, and under which regulation?

answer.text: 2016, under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook page 277, the concept of REIT was introduced in India in 2014 by SEBI, and REITs are registered under the SEBI (REITs) Regulations, 2014. Pages 282-283 provide the related InvIT (2014) and AIF (2012) timeline context. The Trap: The 2012 / AIF Regulations option is a strong distractor because SEBI did notify the AIF Regulations in 2012, but REITs have a separate 2014 framework. LODR (2016) and Mutual Fund Regulations are unrelated regimes. Note: Sequence to remember from the source: AIF Regulations (2012), then REITs and InvITs (both 2014).
